world.seamWrap: longitude wraps at 0/W; latitude does not wrap

generation.recipe: Use fixed coast/river/road geometry in world coordinates. Render overlapping context. Repair each shared edge on one jointly edited strip, then split the same strip back into both tiles. Repair four-way corners jointly. Crop each output core once and assemble at integer coordinates.
passes: tile interiors with fixed overlap context
joint edge and four-way corner corrections
notes: Working size is a composition target, not a claimed image-generation API output size.
An identical pixel address alone does not prove generated terrain continuity.
Existing 36 settlement images are references, not this grid tiles.

detailLevels.rule: At level L world pixels scale by 2^L; tile core stays 2048; each parent has 2x2 children
detailLevels.note: L0 is continental-scale imagery, not settlement roof-scale detail. Local metric scale varies by latitude; later detail LOD must be chosen for the intended visible feature.

sharedGeometry.constraint: Same world-coordinate polyline is referenced by both adjacent tiles. Do not regenerate feature locations per tile.
